name: demo-cyber-denied-drop
select: _timestamp, event_action, event_outcome, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(assumeNotNull(source_ip)), '::ffff:', '') AS source, source_port, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(assumeNotNull(destination_ip)), '::ffff:', '') AS destination, destination_port, network_transport, network_bytes, event_original, cisco_asa_rule_name
where: event_outcome = 'failure' AND event_action != 'logon-failed' AND arrayExists(n -> isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(assumeNotNull(source_ip)), '::ffff:', ''), n), ['42.128.0.0/12', '42.160.0.0/12', '42.208.0.0/12', '147.16.0.0/14', '196.16.0.0/14', '101.134.0.0/15', '112.142.0.0/15', '168.80.0.0/15'])
